Our point of view

Outsourcing should remove management burden—not create another one.

Hiring a rep is only the beginning. Someone still has to recruit, train, coach, supply data, review calls, track performance, manage turnover, and connect the work to revenue.

Capital Generations brings those responsibilities together in one managed engagement. The client gets dedicated sales capacity, while Capital Generations owns the operating work required to keep that capacity productive and accountable.

The company has particularly strong experience in education and complex B2B outreach, where buyer roles, account structures, timing, and real conversation matter.

Frequently asked

About the company

A few practical details about fit, location, and positioning.

Where is Capital Generations based?

Capital Generations is based in New York and supports B2B sales programs with a strong focus on the United States.

What type of company is the best fit?

The strongest fit is typically a growing B2B company—often under 100 employees—with a credible offer, a defined or emerging ideal customer profile, and a Head of Sales or commercial leader who needs more execution capacity.

What is Capital Generations not?

The model is not positioned as a low-cost call center, a shared pool of generic appointment setters, a list broker, or an automated spray-and-pray service. It is managed sales capacity built to represent the client professionally.

Does Capital Generations work outside education?

Yes. Education is a significant area of experience, but the service model applies to B2B companies in other markets where targeted outbound and managed sales capacity are a fit.
